@graph.name: openmoe-bft
@graph.description: Byzantine-fault-tolerant consensus for Mixture-of-Experts routing, plus an EU-AI-Act / A2A compliance toolkit. Wraps each MoE routing decision in a 2f+1 BFT quorum and ships nine absorbed modules: BFT consensus, robust aggregation, debate, EU AI Act checks, cryptographic receipts, hierarchical memory, covenants/web-of-trust, red-team orchestration, and A2A compliance.
@graph.keywords: byzantine fault tolerance, mixture of experts, MoE routing, consensus, EU AI Act, AI governance, AI safety, compliance, A2A, agent2agent, MCP server, red team, robust aggregation, krum, trimmed mean, cryptographic receipts
featureList: Byzantine-fault-tolerant (2f+1) quorum over MoE router replicas
Robust aggregation: coordinate-wise median, trimmed mean, Krum / Multi-Krum
Debate consensus that refines positions before the BFT ledger decides
EU AI Act conformity checks (19 checks across Articles 9-15 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
Hash-chained, tamper-evident cryptographic receipts (HMAC-SHA256, optional Ed25519)
Hierarchical L0-L3 agent memory pyramid with overnight dream() consolidation
Red-team attack-strategy orchestration and resilience scoring
A2A Agent Card validation against the 14 OpenScore safety experts
MCP server over streamable-http exposing evaluate_eu_ai_act, validate_agent_card, red_team_scan, bft_quorum
